Privacy policy

Last updated November 24, 2026

This policy explains how Betteridge Watches collects and uses your information when you browse betteridgewatches.com or send us an inquiry, including through our lead forms on Facebook and Instagram.

What we collect

Inquiry details you give us: your name, email address and phone number, how you would like us to contact you (phone call or WhatsApp text), and your answers about the watch you want to buy, sell or trade, your budget and your timing.

Your shortlist: watches you save on this site are stored only in your own browser. We do not receive your shortlist unless you choose to send it to us.

Basic technical data: like most websites, our hosting provider may automatically record technical details such as your IP address and browser type when you load a page.

How we use it

We use your details to contact you about your inquiry the way you chose, to source and quote watches, to arrange a purchase, sale or trade and its shipping, and to keep records of our conversations with you. We also use it to understand which of our ads bring genuine inquiries.

Who we share it with

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers that help us handle inquiries:

  • Meta (Facebook and Instagram), which hosts our lead forms. We may tell Meta whether an inquiry became a qualified lead, so our ads reach people who are a better fit.
  • Google, where inquiries are stored in Google Sheets.
  • Telegram, which we use to alert our team to new inquiries.

We may also share information if the law requires it, or with shipping carriers to deliver a watch you bought from us.

How long we keep it

We keep inquiry details for as long as we need them to respond to you and for our business records. You can ask us to delete them at any time.

Your choices

You can ask us to show you, correct or delete the information we hold about you, or ask us to stop contacting you. Just tell us on a call or by WhatsApp, or write to us at the address below.
